featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.

just_in.title: Both Parents' Vitamin B12 Levels Linked to Birth Defect Risk, Major Study Finds
just_in.excerpt: A large prospective study from China shows that higher B12 in fathers — not just mothers — before conception is associated with fewer birth defects, a finding with outsized implications for India's B12-deficient population.

food.excerpt: This traditional coriander-based prasad, made with ghee, dry fruits, and roasted spices, is one of the simplest and most beloved offerings for Lord Krishna's birthday.
food.image_caption: Dhaniya panjiri, a traditional Janmashtami prasad made with roasted coriander, dry fruits, and sugar.
food.nri_angle: Panjiri is one of the easiest Janmashtami preparations to replicate abroad, needing only Indian grocery staples.

food.title: Elderly Couple's Steel-Plate Paratha Meal on Flight Goes Viral, Reignites Homemade Food Debate
food.excerpt: A photo of an older couple eating chapatis, sabzi and Amul dahi from a steel thali mid-flight has drawn millions of views and mixed reactions — the latest in a string of viral Indian in-flight food moments.
food.image_caption: An elderly couple eats homemade chapatis, sabzi and Amul dahi from a steel plate during a flight. The image, posted on X by Nalini Unagar on August 30, has gone viral with millions of views.
food.nri_angle: The viral moment reflects a deeply Indian travel tradition — packing ghar ka khana for every journey. For the diaspora, the steel thali and Amul dahi packet are instantly recognizable cultural markers, evoking memories of family trips and home-cooked meals that no airline menu can replace.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sooji or Aata? A Nutritionist Settles the Great Golgappa Shell Debate
food.excerpt: When choosing between semolina and whole-wheat golgappa shells, aata offers a nutritional edge — but the bigger win is keeping them an occasional treat.
food.image_caption: Golgappa, also known as panipuri or puchka, the popular Indian street snack. A nutritionist weighs in on whether sooji or whole-wheat aata shells are the healthier choice.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora families making golgappas at home, choosing the right shell ingredients is entirely in their hands.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Twinkle Khanna and Dimple Kapadia Are Making Paneer at Home. The Fake Paneer Crisis Made Them Do It.
food.excerpt: The author and her mother have turned to homemade paneer amid India's growing food adulteration scandal, sparking a family rivalry over whose kitchen produces more.
food.image_caption: Author and former actress Twinkle Khanna. She and her mother, veteran actress Dimple Kapadia, have started making paneer at home in response to India's fake paneer crisis.
food.nri_angle: For Indian families abroad, homemade paneer has always been standard practice, making the paneer crisis particularly relatable.

travel.title: Uzbekistan Announces 30-Day Visa-Free Entry for Indian Travellers
travel.excerpt: The visa waiver, announced during PM Modi's state visit, eliminates the previous e-visa requirement and comes alongside a UPI payment agreement for Indian travelers in Uzbekistan.

travel.title: Six Budget Weekend Getaways From Delhi Under ₹6,000 for September
travel.excerpt: Monsoon shoulder season means lush landscapes, smaller crowds and pre-festive pricing on trips to Rishikesh, Jaipur, Agra, Lansdowne, Alwar and Mathura-Vrindavan.
travel.image_caption: Jama Masjid in Delhi. Six destinations within easy reach of the capital offer budget-friendly weekend getaways for September.
travel.nri_angle: Budget-friendly weekend escapes for NRIs visiting family in Delhi during September's monsoon shoulder season.

travel.title: Young Indians Are Turning Family Homes Into Holiday Rentals, and It's Reshaping Travel
travel.excerpt: Gen Z Airbnb hosts in India grew nearly 40% in the first half of 2026, with rural hosting up 60% as young hosts open doors in unexpected destinations.
travel.nri_angle: Diaspora travelers visiting India now have more diverse accommodation options in smaller cities and rural areas through young hosts.

carousel.title: Canada Fast-Tracks Citizenship for Students as Processing Times Hit 25 Months
carousel.excerpt: An urgent processing route lets eligible applicants receive their citizenship certificate in time for the school semester, even as a post-Bill C-3 surge has overwhelmed standard timelines.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans with Canadian ancestry can use the fast-track route to claim Canadian citizenship for education, benefiting from domestic tuition rates and dual citizenship with both countries.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Modi Demands End to Terror Double Standards at SCO Summit in Bishkek
carousel.excerpt: At the 26th SCO Summit in Kyrgyzstan, PM Modi called for dismantling the entire ecosystem of terrorism while sharing warm exchanges with Xi Jinping and Putin — as Pakistan's Sharif stood by without interaction.
carousel.image_caption: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the SCO Summit. Modi called on member states to end double standards on terrorism and pushed for greater counter-terror cooperation.
carousel.nri_angle: India's anti-terrorism stance and frozen India-Pakistan ties directly affect diaspora communities through visa policies, security postures, and bilateral relations.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Adnan Sami Blasts Bollywood's Remix Addiction: 'Corporates Are Scared to Experiment'
carousel.excerpt: The singer-composer says music labels have flipped the original-to-remix ratio from 80:20 to 20:80, starving a generation of its own songs.
carousel.nri_angle: Bollywood music serves as a cultural anchor for diaspora Indians, and the remix trend threatens to dilute the generational connection to original Hindi film songs.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Bumrah Returns to India Squad for Afghanistan T20I Series, Subject to Fitness Clearance
carousel.excerpt: India's pace spearhead is back in the 15-member squad for the three-match T20I series in New Delhi, with Shreyas Iyer captaining and teenager Vaibhav Sooryavanshi earning a call-up.
carousel.image_caption: Jasprit Bumrah bowls during an India international match. The pace spearhead has been named in India's squad for the Afghanistan T20I series, subject to fitness clearance.
carousel.nri_angle: The Afghanistan series offers Indian cricket fans in the US, where T20 cricket is rapidly growing, a chance to watch Bumrah's anticipated comeback ahead of the ODI World Cup cycle.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Notifies Rs 1.28 Lakh Crore Semicon 2.0 Scheme to Build End-to-End Chip Ecosystem
carousel.excerpt: The government has formalized its most ambitious semiconductor policy, covering chip design to fabrication with $13 billion in incentives, minority stakes in startups, and a target of capturing 10 percent of the global chip market.
carousel.image_caption: India has notified its Rs 1.28 lakh crore Semicon 2.0 scheme to build an end-to-end domestic chip ecosystem spanning design, fabrication, and equipment manufacturing.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin semiconductor professionals in Silicon Valley and global chip companies have a tangible pathway for ventures and investment in India's expanding chip ecosystem.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Sugar Stocks Soar Up to 59% on Dalal Street, but Analysts Warn Valuations Are Running Ahead
carousel.excerpt: Rising domestic prices, tight global supplies and El Niño fears have sent sugar counters surging, yet experts say the market has already priced in two strong quarters.
carousel.image_caption: A stock market display board shows trading data on an Indian exchange. Sugar stocks rallied up to 59% in August as domestic prices hit record levels amid supply concerns.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian investors with exposure to BSE-listed sugar stocks face a classic cyclical trade amplified by ethanol policy — strength justified but extrapolation risky.
